replies.author: Matic0B
replies.body:
I agree with others saying the islands should be an equal amount of blocks away from each other but I'll add some more feedback for you.

The islands could be refined when it comes to their shape. You placed blocks in a straight diagonal line. I recommend making them look more circular and more natural since the straight lines aren't the most pleasant to look at. You could also add some coal ore and similar things into the stone part of the islands to add some more detail and possibly develop new tactics by adding extra materials  like iron or diamond ore (but in a risky spot, possibly on a whole new island behind the regular ones with barely any cover - high risk, high reward)

The middle wooden building could use some work. Seems very blocky with all straight walls and rough edges. I recommend you add some things like having the roof overhang by a block and improving the floor so its not just flat and floating. The jungle leaves floating down from the house also don't look that good. Maybe you should experiment with vines, that would also make it harder for people to go to the bottom chest. Again, high risk, high reward.

Since you have enchanting tables on the map, do you also have a way to get XP? Mining coal to later smelt stone could be a good way to go about it and adding some experience bottles. 

As for the chests way on the bottom of the map, unless you have some amazing loot in there, noone will bother to go down there as its way too hard and dangerous.

Another tiny detail would be matching biomes. You can do this with World Edit.

Other than that, Its not that bad, just lacks some detail and should have islands equaly far from the middle.
